limitations: Does not establish full singular-locus exhaustion, geometric irreducibility of every special fiber, or maximum number of nodes in positive characteristic. Older literature may contain equivalent prime-uniform arithmetic observations; independent mathematical validation has not occurred.
scientific_integrity: The new claim is the odd-characteristic survival of 65 designated ordinary nodes. The classical characteristic-zero configuration is credited to Barth. The result is supported by finite exact arithmetic in the rank-two integer ring and a general argument reducing all odd prime characteristics to these integral identities.
title: The 65 classical Barth-sextic nodes persist in every odd characteristic
